gates.detail: 6/6 agree [alpha1=0.79646 vs ref 0.79646; alpha2=0.86603 vs ref 0.86603; abs_diff=1.1102e-15 vs ref 0; young_mean_a1=1.0452 vs ref 1.0452; old_mean_a1=1.3868 vs ref 1.3868; aging_effect=0.34161 vs ref 0.34161]
gates.citation: Peng CK, Havlin S, Stanley HE, Goldberger AL (1995). Quantification of scaling exponents and crossover phenomena in nonstationary heartbeat time series. Chaos 5(1):82-87. Aging: Iyengar N et al. (1996). Data: Fantasia (Iyengar et al. 1996), PhysioNet.

reference.citation: Peng CK, Havlin S, Stanley HE, Goldberger AL (1995). Quantification of scaling exponents and crossover phenomena in nonstationary heartbeat time series. Chaos 5(1):82-87. Aging: Iyengar N et al. (1996). Data: Fantasia (Iyengar et al. 1996), PhysioNet.
reference.description: recomputes alpha1/alpha2 with an independent log-spaced standard-DFA (base stats::lm) and compares to ecgDFA's (machine precision, |diff| < 1e-13); reports the aging effect -- alpha1 young mean 1.045 (healthy fractal ~1.0) vs elderly mean 1.387 (elevated), aging_effect 0.342
